A '''jolt cell''' was a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] produced by [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Power Cells]]. It came in [[Jolt cell Mark I|three]] [[Jolt cell Mark II|different]] [[Jolt cell Mark III|power ratings]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|171|jolt cell}}</ref>
